newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends up against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends up against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.2924 against the U.S. dollar from 8.2936 on Thursday in Shanghai on a technical rebound, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2924.
With the central bank seen reducing its intervention to depress the yuan today, the local currency rebounded after Thursday's falls, dealers said.
The yuan opened up at 8.2924 and consolidated around the 8.2920 level for most of the session, hitting an intraday low of 8.2925 and a high of 8.2918.
Trading was dull with many investors reluctant to trade ahead of the weekend, dealers said.

"As long as the central eases its curbs on the yuan's upward momentum, the big demand for yuan will push it up," another dealer said. "But the 8.2920 level seems to be a resistance point hard to breach."
Dealers said they expected the yuan to continue to move stably below the 8.2920 level early next week.
The yuan closed up at 7.1100 from 7.1800 against 100 Japanese yen and little changed at 1.0711 from 1.0712 against the Hong Kong dollar.
